exposure: Public insurance status (Sehat Card Plus user vs. non-user)
cohort: Participants were 1,853 patients undergoing exploratory laparotomy, lower segment caesarean section, or open reduction internal fixation of fractures in public and private tertiary hospitals in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.
finding: Sehat Card Plus users experienced a significantly higher length of stay and a lower 14-day readmission rate compared to non-users, with no significant difference in 30-day readmission or overall mortality.
